workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Wrote CUDA kernels for the attention layers in an internal inference library, speeding up long prompts by 1.8 times on H100 GPUs
• Built a benchmark suite that runs on every pull request across four GPU types and posts its results back to the code review
• Profiled memory use across 30 models and moved two buffers onto shared memory, so the largest models run with twice the batch size

• Built a feature in Azure DevOps that suggests reviewers for a pull request from who last changed the same files and how quickly they reviewed
• Wrote the service in C# and the page in TypeScript and React, and rolled it out to 5,000 internal repositories behind a feature flag
• Wrote the design doc and led its review with three senior engineers

• Run a weekly recitation for 35 students and hold office hours on the malloc, shell and proxy labs, the hardest three of the term
• Rewrote the cache lab's autograder in Python so students see why tests fail
• Wrote 12 new practice problems and their solutions for exam reviews

projectsSection.projectDescription: • A replicated key-value store built on Raft with snapshots and membership changes, tested under random network partitions

• A course planner that checks a four-year schedule against degree rules and prerequisites, used by 1,200 students each term
• Scrapes the course catalog nightly and keeps each plan in the browser
